bagPolicy.summary: Bags and purses of any size are not allowed. Wallets and wristlets up to 5" x 8" x 1" are permitted.
allowed: Wallets and wristlets up to 5" x 8" x 1"
prohibited: Bags and purses of any size
bagPolicy.note: A dedicated screening lane is available for guests with medical, dietary or childcare needs, with one bag permitted.

parking.note: Parking is available immediately around the arena with over 10,000 surface and garage spaces within walking distance. Parking lots are cashless, accepting credit/debit cards and smartphone payments only. Lots typically open 2 hours prior to event doors.

rideshare.note: Drop-off is on Borror Drive along the north side. After the event, select Schottenstein Center in your rideshare app for the available pickup area. Ask Guest Services at Section 127 for help.

concessions.note: The Schottenstein Center offers a variety of food and drink options, with a focus on responsible alcohol consumption. Alcohol sales are managed according to specific guidelines and may be cut off at designated times during events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Schottenstein Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is prohibited except for personal emergencies. Arrange an exception with a supervisor at a rotunda before leaving.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Ticket Office (venue's Northeast corner) lobby is open from 9AM to 4PM Monday thru Friday with extended hours on event days for assistance or the purchase of available tickets.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Schottenstein Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
